reviewer: Coding assistant qualitative review of original retained citation windows
selection: First ten held-out questions in deterministic study order for each dataset, hybrid method only
blinding: Reference answers were visible. No independent human reviewer or second rater participated.
criterion: The cited window must support the complete answer as a response to the question. A comparison needs both sides; shared answer words alone do not suffice.
scope: Exploratory case analysis, not a population faithfulness estimate
